digest.component_or_area: binding store persistence and selective publication
propositions: Repository checkpoints and local multi-file persistence must not independently trigger selective publication; publication ownership must remain in reconcile_helpers.py
Ticket publication must stage only the existing five bridge-state allowlisted files, never broaden staging or publish each repository checkpoint
Unchanged passes must create no commit; GET rotation and retired-first failure cases must preserve pre-extraction publication and recovery floors

Repository versus publication ownership, ordered partial-state behavior, rollback decisions, and explicit no-journal/no-format-migration rules must be durably documented in ADR 0099 with regression test coverage
Facade persistence delegation must maintain five-file allowlist and existing selective-publication semantics through full binding-state regression suite after superseded branches are removed
